title: ClimbPayload
description: Wire-format envelope sent from the Android companion app to the Garmin Connect IQ datafield. Canonical source — Java POJOs are generated from this file. Monkey C classes are hand-mirrored and kept honest by the protocol round-trip tests on both sides.

v.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes; consumers reject payloads with an unknown version.

mode.description: Watch operating mode for this payload. 'route' = follow a single route; 'radius' = catalog of nearby climbs anchored by start coordinate.

routeId.description: Stable identifier for the route (route mode only). Phone uses this to detect changed payloads on re-sync.

name.description: Optional user-supplied display name for the route. Only included when it fits the byte budget; watch falls back to a derived label otherwise.

surfaceSections.description: Optional user-defined surface overrides and named flat sections for arbitrary stretches of the route (route mode only), ordered by startDistance. Wire encoding: 'surfSec' array of objects {s:startDistance, e:endDistance, t:surfaceType, n:name?, cp:[distance,latInt,lonInt, ...]}.

climbs.description: Ordered list of climbs. In route mode: ordered by startDistance along the route. In radius mode: ordered by phone-side proximity to last known location (closest first).

startDistance.description: Route mode: cumulative distance along the route (meters) where the climb begins.

endDistance.description: Route mode: cumulative distance along the route (meters) where the climb ends.

startLat.description: Radius mode: latitude of the climb start (decimal degrees, WGS84).

startLon.description: Radius mode: longitude of the climb start (decimal degrees, WGS84).

length.description: Climb length in meters. Domain rule: a climb has length >= 800.

elevationGain.description: Total elevation gain across the climb in meters (rounded).

avgGradient.description: Average gradient as fixed-point: percent x 10. e.g. 7.2% is encoded as 72. Domain rule: avgGradient >= 30 (i.e. >= 3.0%).

name.description: Optional user-supplied display name for the climb. Same budget rules as the route name.

segments.description: 8%-of-climb-length segments covering the full climb. Count is typically 12 or 13.

targetSeconds.description: Optional per-segment target time in whole seconds, parallel to 'segments' (same length; the length equality is enforced by the round-trip tests, not by this schema). Precomputed phone-side from the rider profile (route-mode only). Wire encoding: packed int array 'tsec'. Omitted entirely when no pacing plan is available (never emitted as an empty array, hence minItems 1).

elevationGain.description: Segment elevation gain in meters (can be negative on very mild segments that dip slightly within an overall climb).

gradient.description: Segment average gradient as fixed-point: percent x 10. May be negative for dips within a climb.

colorIndex.description: Color category derived from gradient. See protocol/colors.md for the cutoff table.

startDistance.description: Metres from route start where the section begins.

endDistance.description: Metres from route start where the section ends. Must exceed startDistance.

name.description: Optional user-supplied display name for the section, shown on the watch surface datafield.

checkpoints.description: GPS checkpoints along the section for distance-correction on the watch. Wire encoding: packed int array 'cp' of [distanceFromRouteStart, latInt, lonInt, ...] where latInt/lonInt = degrees x 100000.
